name: Msiexec Quiet Installation
description:
Adversaries may abuse msiexec.exe to proxy execution of malicious payloads.
Msiexec.exe is the command-line utility for the Windows Installer and is thus commonly associated with executing installation packages (.msi)
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: WindowsApps installing updates via the quiet flag
query: ((process.executable:*\\msiexec.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:msiexec.exe) AND (process.command_line:(*\-i* OR *\/i* OR *–i* OR *—i* OR *―i*) OR process.command_line:(*\-package* OR *\/package* OR *–package* OR *—package* OR *―package*) OR process.command_line:(*\-a* OR *\/a* OR *–a* OR *—a* OR *―a*) OR process.command_line:(*\-j* OR *\/j* OR *–j* OR *—j* OR *―j*)) AND process.command_line:(*\-q* OR *\/q* OR *–q* OR *—q* OR *―q*)) AND (NOT ((process.parent.executable:C\:\\Users\\* AND process.parent.executable:*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*) OR process.parent.executable:C\:\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR (process.parent.executable:C\:\\Windows\\CCM\\Ccm32BitLauncher.exe AND (winlog.event_data.IntegrityLevel:(System OR S\-1\-16\-16384)))))
